en: The image is an illustrated postcard showing a large industrial brewery complex with multiple buildings, tall smokestacks emitting smoke, and a bustling railway station nearby. The scene is set against a rocky hillside, and many people, trains, and carriages are visible, indicating industrial activity. There is an inset image at the bottom showing a closer view of the same area with more detail of the train station and brewery. Some German text is visible at the bottom of the postcard.
